title: Create: Extensive
description: Create: Extensive is a large 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack centered on Create and its many addons. It offers massive automation, factories, building, and world exploration with tons of content.
body:
# Create: Extensive

**Create: Extensive** is a massive Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack built around the Create mod and its incredibly deep ecosystem of addons.

With over 250 mods, this pack delivers one of the most extensive Create experiences possible — turning vanilla Minecraft into a true sandbox of automation, engineering, building, and exploration.
Standout Features:

### **Create Aeronautics** - The best physics mod to exist:
Build and pilot fully functional airships, planes, drones, hot-air balloons, cars, trucks, and other physics-based vehicles. Take to the skies with realistic movement and explore the world like never before!

### **Exploring Taken To The Next Level** :
A full dedicated category of exploration content that pairs perfectly with Create Aeronautics. Use your custom-built vehicles to soar across vast landscapes and discover new biomes! Venture to outer space in a rocket, exploring planets filled with unique structures, resources, and adventures!

### **Massive Create Ecosystem:**
Dozens of Create addons including Create: Big Cannons, Create: Connected, Create: Deco, Create: Encased, Create: Stuff & Additions, Create: Trains, Create: Power Loader, Create: Ultimate Factory, Create Addition, and many more. Build mega-factories, automated production lines, and industrial empires.

### **Stunning World Generation:**
Terralith + the full Yungs' Better series (Dungeons, Mineshafts, Strongholds, Temples, Nether Fortresses, Ocean Monuments, etc.) creates beautiful, varied, and highly explorable worlds.

### **Building & Decoration Overhaul:**
Chipped, Unusual Furniture, Let's Do series (Furniture, Vinery, Meadow, Beach Party, Herbal Brews), Supplementaries, Create Deco, Design-n-Decor, Framed Blocks, and my personal favorite, Rechiseled, accompanied by many more for endless creative possibilities!

### **Automation, Storage & Tech:**
Advanced contraptions, trains, pipes, Tom's Storage, Sophisticated Backpacks, and factory expansions.

### **Performance & Quality of Life:**
Sodium + Lithium + FerriteCore + ImmediatelyFast + Entity Culling + ModernFix for smooth gameplay. Includes Jade (+ addons), JEI/EMI, MouseTweaks, Xaero's Minimap + World Map, Waystones, Voice Chat, Carry On, Falling Tree, Essential, and many more!

### **Multiplayer Ready:**
Full support for servers with Essential and Voice Chat.

### **Perfect For:**
Players who love mega automation, creative engineering, epic vehicle building, and true exploration. Whether you're constructing a steampunk sky fleet, an underground industrial complex, or piloting your custom airship to discover new planets and biomes — Create: Extensive gives you the tools to do it all!

**Note:** This is a large and resource-heavy modpack. Allocate 8–12 GB of RAM (or more) for the best performance.
